query: SELECT prereq.node_key AS from_key, dep.node_key AS to_key, e.kind, e.artifact_id FROM central.workflow_edges e JOIN central.workflow_nodes dep ON dep.id = e.dependent_node_id JOIN central.workflow_nodes prereq ON prereq.id = e.prerequisite_node_id WHERE e.run_id = $1 ORDER BY dep.node_key, prereq.node_key, e.kind
